programs.title: Scooby-Doo and Guess Who?
programs.desc: Scooby-Doo takes the gang to meet his good friend, Lucy Liu, at her art gallery in Queens. She's having a big gallery opening, but when one of her large humanoid modern sculptures comes alive and attacks them, the gang and Lucy have a real mystery on their hands. Can our gang help Lucy Liu save her gallery opening and trap the monster? Or will they all be painted into a corner, permanently!
